items.q: Do you like sports? Why or why not?
items.ans:
Yes，I like sports very much.
First, I think playing sports is fun. I believe playing sports is a good way to relax
myself. Second, it gives people the opportunity to make new friends. I have made
some new friends when I play sports. Third, sports helps me keep healthy. It is good
for my health.

items.q: Who is your favorite sports star? Why?
items.ans:
My favorite sportsman is Li Na. First, She is hard-working. She usually plays tennis
more than six hours a day. Her coach is moved deeply by her and this is the reason why
she is my favorite sportsman. Second, Li Na is warm-hearted. she always gives
money to charity and help those people in need. As a successful sportsman, she never
thinks that she is more clever than anyone else.

items.q: What school club do you want to join? Why?
items.ans:
I want to join the sports club. Because first, I like playing sports, like
basketball ,soccer and so on. doing sports is good for my health. It can make me relaxed
and strong. Second, I can make more friends in the club. I have made some friends
when playing sports.

items.q: Do you like P.E.? why？
items.ans:
Yes, I do. It can make me feel relaxed. I can do sports in P.E class. It is good for my
health.

items.q: Do you like English? Why or why not?
items.ans:
Yes, I do. I like English very much. First it’s very useful, and it’s a very important
subject. I want to travel around the world. It will be fun to make friends with people
from other countries. Second, our English teacher is very funny. She is very kind and
2
friendly. We all love her. She always makes the English classes enjoyable.

items.q: What’s your favorite food? Why do you like it/them?
items.ans:
My favorite food is the dumplings that my mother makes. First, it is a way that my
mother shows her love to me .Although my mother is busy, she makes dumplings at
least once a week. Every time I eat the dumplings that my mother makes ,I feel very
excited and lucky. Second, the dumplings are very delicious. Third , dumplings are
Chinese traditional food. We usually eat them in Spring Festival.

items.q: Do you think teenagers should be allowed to choose their own clothes? Why or
items.ans:
why not?
I think teenagers should be allowed to choose their own clothes. First, teenagers
want to look smart and energetic. But their uniforms are not very beautiful. And
wearing their own clothes makes them original. It makes them feel confident. Second,
children are not small children. They should learn to make decisions by themselves.
If they choose their own clothes, they will feel more comfortable.

items.q: Do you like playing computer games? Why or why not?
items.ans:
To tell the truth, I don’t like playing computer games. First, it is boring. Playing
computer games can take us too much time and we have no time to study or play sports.
We can get nothing from the computer games. It’s a waste of time. Second, playing
computer games is bad for our eyes and our health. Playing computer games too
much or too often is dangerous. We will fall in love with it then we will give up
studying. So, I don’t like to play computer games.

items.q: Where are you going to be when you grow up? Why?
items.ans:
When I grow up, I want to be a reporter. First as a reporter, I can meet many
interesting people .I can know many important things. I can travel around the world.
Second, I can write articles for newspapers. I will have many opportunities to talk
with the famous people and ask them questions. It can open up my mind. In a word,
being a reporter is my dream.
3

items.q: What’s your favorite subject? Why do you like it?
items.ans:
I like English best.  First it’s very useful, and it’s a very important subject. I want
to travel around the world. It will be fun to make friends with people from other
countries. Second, our English teacher is very funny. My English teacher is very kind
and friendly. We all love her. She always makes the English classes enjoyable.

items.q: What’s your favorite season? Why do you like it?
items.ans:
Summer is my favorite season. First, we can wear light T-shirts. It is pretty beautiful.
Second, we have a long holiday. There are also many kinds of activities for us to enjoy
ourselves. We can go to the beach. We can swim and surf in the sea .It’s really fun. We
can also eat ice-cream! How cool!

items.q: What are you going to do this summer vacation?
items.ans:
I think we will have a great holiday this summer vacation. First, I will have a
good rest. Then I will go somewhere interesting with my classmates. Second, I will
read some educational books and fill my mind with the knowledge. Third, I will do
some exercise to make me stronger and healthier. I will spend more time playing
sports because I don’t have too much free time during the school days. I think I will
have a happy holiday!

items.q: What are the good ways of learning English well?
items.ans:
First, I think studying grammar is a great way to learn English. It’s important to
learn English by taking grammar notes. Second, reading aloud to practice
pronunciation can also help a lot. We can read after the tape to correct our
pronunciation. Third, joining the English club at school is also a good way to
improve English. We get lots of practice and have fun.

items.q: If you go sightseeing, what transportation will you take? Why?
items.ans:
If I go sightseeing, I will take the plane. First of all, it’s very convenient. I think
plane is the fastest and safest transportation. I don’t like to spend too much time on the
4
way. Second, when I am on a plane, I can enjoy beautiful clouds and watch
different places through the window. It’s amazing.

items.q: What do you usually do after school? Why?
items.ans:
After school, I usually play Ping-Pong and listen to gentle music. First,
Ping-Pong is my favorite sport. I can stay in good health by playing Ping-Pong.
Second, I can also feel relaxed and get peaceful by listening to music, especially
after I finish lots of homework. I’ll feel happy by doing these things.

items.q: Do you want to be a volunteer? Why or why not?
items.ans:
Yes, I’m willing to become a volunteer. First, I can get a lot of happiness when I
help others. I have fun when I help with the housework or sing songs for the old people
in an old people’s home. Second , I can put my love to good use. I am happy to
spend time helping others. Helping others is something I always want to do. Third, I
can meet a lot of people. It is a good experience for my future job. If I can become a
volunteer, I’ll try my best to help people in need.

items.q: Do you like to wear school uniforms? Why or why not?
items.ans:
Yes, I like to wear school uniforms. First, I think it’s our school rules. I should
obey the rules. Second, I think our school uniform is beautiful. By wearing the
school uniforms, we will look smart and we will concentrate more on our studies. Third,
wearing school uniforms helps us save time. We don’t think about what to wear
before going to school every day.

items.q: Do you often help your parents with chores? Why or why not?
items.ans:
Yes, I often help my parents with chores. First, my parents have a lot of things to
do every day, they are too tired. If I help them do some housework, they can have a
rest, and that will make me feel happy. Second, my parents give me all their love and
care. They help me when I need them. Now I am old enough to do something for them.
Third, it’s my duty to do housework because I am a member of a family.
5

items.q: What’s your favorite fruit? Why do you like it/them?
items.ans:
My favorite fruit is apples. First, I think apples are the most delicious fruit.
When I am hungry, an apple is enough for me..Second, eating apples is very good for
our health. An apple a day keeps the doctor away. Third, my hometown is famous for
apples. On weekends, my parents and I usually go to my hometown in the countryside
and help pick apples. It’s a lot of fun.

items.q: Which country do you want to travel to? Why? (说出至少两条理由)
items.ans:
I want to travel to Singapore. First, I think Singapore is a very beautiful place to
go sightseeing. The weather in Singapore is neither too hot nor too cold. More than
three quarters of the population are Chinese, so you can simply speak Putonghua a lot of
time. Second, it is an English-speaking country. I can practice English in
Singapore.

items.q: What is a good pet for a 6-year-old child? Why? (说出至少两条理由)
items.ans:
I think for a 6-year-old child, a good pet is a dog. First, dogs are very lovely. Most
kids like them. Dogs are friendly, too. Kids like playing with them. Second, they are
easy to take care of. They can also help us do some useful things. It can help the blind
cross the road.

items.q: Which do you think is better, getting up late or getting up early? Why? (说出至
items.ans:
少两条理由)
I think getting up early is better. First, getting up early is a good habit. it is good
for our health. Second, we can have enough time to do other things. If we get up
early, we can have much free time. We can do sports or do some reading. We can also
help mum make breakfast.

items.q: Do you like your English teacher? Why or why not? (说出至少两条理由)
items.ans:
Yes, I like my English teacher. First, she is very kind, and she is friendly to us.
When we are in trouble, she always helps us out. We all regard her as our best friend.
Second, She has many ways to make her class lively and interesting.
6

items.q: What’s your favorite animal? Why do you like it? (说出至少两条理由)
items.ans:
My favorite animal is dogs. First, Dogs are very lovely and friendly. I like playing
with them. Second, they are easy to take care of. They can also help us do some useful
things. They can help the blind cross the road. I think they are my good friends. I like
them very much.

items.q: Should friends be different or the same? Why do you think that way? (说出至
items.ans:
少两条理由) I think friends should be the same. First, we have many same hobbies.
So we can do many things together. For example, we often do sports and watch TV
together. Second, We have the same tastes, we will never argue with each other. We
often help each other and learn from each other.

items.q: What do you think is the most helpful invention? Why? (说出至少两条理由)
items.ans:
I think the light bulb is the most helpful invention. First, it can give us more time
to work and play every day. I like reading and I will have more time to do some
reading. We don’t have to live in the dark. It makes our life more convenient. Second, it
can  make our city beautiful. With the light we won’t be afraid of the dark.

items.q: Do you like loud music？Why or why not? (说出至少两条理由)
items.ans:
No, I don’t loud music. First, I think loud music makes people feel tense. It
sounds noisy. Second, it is bad for our ears. Loud music can also affect our neighbors.
So we had better listen to soft music. Soft music makes us relaxed.

items.q: Do you like advertising? Why or why not? (说出至少两条理由)
items.ans:
No, I don’t like advertising. First, I think some advertising can be confusing or
misleading. Sometimes the words sound good but don’t really tell you anything about
the quality of the product. At other times, the picture in an ad looks a lot better than the
real thing, so you have to be careful.At times an ad can lead you to buy something you
don’t need at all. Second, they make our city dirty.
7

items.q: What subject are you good at? How do you study it?
items.ans:
I am good at English. I have many good ways to study English. First, I usually
study English by listening to the tape. And I think taking notes in class is also very
useful. Sometimes Second, I study English by watching English movies. Memorizing
the words of pop songs also helps a lot. I also join the English club at school.

you think so.

items.q: What is your dream job? What will you do to make it come true?
items.ans:
My dream job is to become a reporter. First, I think this job is very interesting.
And I will meet many different people. And I can make friends with them. Second, I
like traveling. If I’m a reporter, I can travel all over the world. This makes me feel
excited.

items.q: How do you study for a test?
items.ans:
First of all, I study by working with a group. I have learned a lot that way. Second, I
study by practicing conversations with friends. It improves my speaking skills. Third,
I study by asking the teacher for help. It helps me a lot.

items.q: How do you learn English best?
items.ans:
First, I usually study English by practicing conversations with friends .I think it can
improve my speaking skills. Second, listening to tapes is a good way to improve my
listening skills. And I often do some reading. In this way, I can learn many new words
and improve my reading skills. Third, I also keep writing something to improve my
writing skills. When I have problems, I often ask the teacher for help.

items.q: How do you deal with your problems?
items.ans:

First, I usually deal with my problems by learning to forget. In this way, good
friendship can’t be lost. Second, I also deal with problems by regarding problems as

items.q: Have you helped others? What did you do?
items.ans:
Yes. I like helping others. First, I often help my classmates solve problems. I’m

items.q: What do you think the life will be like in 100 years?
items.ans:
First, I think great changes will take place in 100 years. People will live to be more
than 120 years old. Children won’t go to school; they will study on computers instead.
Second, Maybe in 100 years, everything will be free. And I think every family will
have their own robots.
But I think if we want our lives much better than now, we must protect the environment
from now.

items.q: If you lost your way, what should you do?

items.q: What should we do to keep healthy？
items.ans:
I think we should eat a balanced diet. Eating healthy food can make us energetic.
We should do more exercise. Doing exercise can make us become stronger. We
also need to have enough sleep. Staying up is bad for our health.

items.q: Do you have a healthy lifestyle? Why?

No, I don’t. Because it’s bad for my health. Although junk food tastes good, it

items.q: Do you think breakfast is important? Why?
items.ans:
Yes, I think breakfast is very important.

Second, eating breakfast is good for our study. If we eat breakfast well, we can

items.q: What are you going to do after you leave school?
items.ans:

items.q: List some rules of your school/family.
items.ans:

14

items.q: What school rules do you think should be changed? Why?

items.q: What do you usually do on the Internet?

items.q: What do people in different countries do when they meet for the first time?
items.ans:
In China, people always shake hands when they meet for the first time. In America,
people are also supposed to shake hands when they meet. But the people in Japan
and Korea usually bow when they meet. However, in Brazil, people are supposed to kiss
when they meet for the first time.

items.q: Do you like going to the mall? Why or why not?

items.q: What would you do if you had a million dollars?
items.ans:

items.q: How do you feel when you see animals in the zoo?

one I liked or that was suitable for animals to live in. I don’t think it is a good way for
animals to live in a zoo.
